_comment: Evidence store for the CSRBT kit. Files here are CONTENT-ADDRESSED: the name carries the first 8 hex of the sha256 of the bytes, so a file that has been altered no longer matches its own name. sha256 is the identity; everything else in an entry is a claim about the file that tools/verify/verify_evidence.py re-derives from the bytes rather than trusting. self_certifying records whether the FILE proves its own origin (EXIF, GPS, timestamp) or whether the site attribution rests on testimony -- those are not the same evidence and must not read as if they were.

tahoe-westshore-a42a4047.png.self_certifying_note: no EXIF, no tIME, no GPS chunk -- the file records nothing about when or where it was made
tahoe-westshore-a42a4047.png.site_attribution: asserted by the observer, not carried by the file
tahoe-westshore-a42a4047.png.subject: montane mixed-conifer stand on a slope bench above the lake, looking ENE to the Carson Range
